query:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM blocks b
            JOIN tasks t ON t.block_id = b.id
            WHERE b.lesson_id = $1
              AND b.kind = 'task'
              AND b.retired_at IS NULL
              AND t.retired_at IS NULL
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM task_attempts a
                  WHERE a.user_id = $2 AND a.task_id = t.id AND a.correct
              )
        )
